nrw.title: UT Arlington - Non-Resident Tuition Waiver and Grants (2026-2027 eligibility)

test_policy.notes: The international first-year page says UTA is test optional (SAT/ACT help with admission decisions, testing exemptions and scholarships). Guaranteed admission: 3.25+ GPA with no test minimum; 3.0-3.24 GPA with SAT 1130 / ACT 23; 2.90-2.99 with SAT 1250 / ACT 26. Everyone else gets individual holistic review (a personal statement is requested) and is admitted conditionally, needing a 2.0 GPA after the first term. Conflict: the UTA catalog still says freshmen educated outside the U.S. need SAT 980 / ACT 19, so confirm with UTA.

requirements.notes: UTA recommends the Common App but also accepts ApplyTexas ('own'); the fee is $75 and non-refundable. Non-U.S. transcripts must be uploaded for review by Foreign Credentials Service of America (FCSA), which charges a $90 processing fee. No essay is required for guaranteed admission.

deadlines.label: Fall priority date, first-year (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Applications are accepted after the priority date, but meeting it ensures guaranteed consideration. The page prints no year; fall 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: Merit-based scholarship deadline
deadlines.notes: Application and all required documents must be in by then for scholarship consideration.

deadlines.label: International students: fall priority application deadline
deadlines.notes: From the UTA catalog's priority-deadline table (international fall May 1; spring Oct 1; summer Mar 1). Decisions take about 3-5 weeks after the file is complete. The catalog does not print a year; fall 2027 is assumed and the first-year page's Feb 15 priority date is earlier.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required from international students from non-native English-speaking countries. Exempt: graduates of secondary or post-secondary schools in listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, New Zealand, United Kingdom, Singapore, South Africa), who meet English proficiency; SAT verbal 480 or ACT English 19; English Composition I and II with C or better plus 24 U.S. transferable hours; English-based IB, AP, American or British curriculum completion; or a U.S.-accredited degree. Scores must be sent directly by the testing provider.

english.notes: 105 for engineering majors; 100 for all other majors.

aid.notes: Every incoming freshman is reviewed for the Maverick Academic Scholarship ($1,000-$8,000 a year for fall, renewable up to three more years; SAT/ACT optional). For 2026-27, non-residents receiving the $8,000 Maverick award (or Presidential Honors $13,000 / Presidential $10,000) are eligible for a Non-Resident Tuition Waiver (in-state rates); lower awards carry an International Grant of up to $10,000 ($4,000 award), $8,000 ($2,000 award) or $5,000 ($1,000 award). Waivers and grants are not guaranteed and depend on funding. UTA's pages did not state whether need-based aid exists for international students.

sat.note: No numeric SAT code is printed on the pages read; pick UT Arlington in the College Board search.

act.note: No numeric ACT code is printed on the pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No institution code is printed on the pages read; scores must come directly from ETS.
